name: ToN_IoT: IoT and IIoT Cybersecurity Dataset
description: ToN_IoT is a comprehensive cybersecurity benchmark capturing telemetry from Internet of Things (IoT) and Industrial IoT (IIoT) sensors, operating systems (Linux, Windows), and network traffic. Created in the Cyber Range Lab at UNSW Canberra, it incorporates diverse attack scenarios including DoS, DDoS, Ransomware, Backdoor, Injection, XSS, Scanning, and Password cracking against physical and simulated IoT testbeds.
